job.title: Sales Enablement Senior Manager
job.description:
Hybrid | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | Excellent Benefits

Are you passionate about helping sales teams perform at their highest level? Do you enjoy creating impactful training programs, developing sales content, and equipping teams with the tools they need to win?

Labelmaster is seeking a Sales Enablement Senior Manager to support and strengthen our Sales and Customer Success organizations. In this newly created role, you will develop the content, training, and enablement programs that drive seller effectiveness, improve customer engagement, and accelerate revenue growth.

This is more than a traditional training role. You'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders to build onboarding programs, create seller playbooks, develop competitive messaging, and ensure our teams are prepared to effectively engage buyers throughout the customer journey.

We are an established and growing company that takes the complexity out of shipping Dangerous Goods (Hazmat), making the world a safer place.

What You'll Do

  • Develop sales playbooks, battle cards, case studies, and competitive messaging
  • Create and deliver onboarding and ongoing training programs
  • Manage seller readiness, certifications, and product knowledge training
  • Partner with Sales Leadership on coaching and skill development
  • Gather field feedback and improve sales content and training initiatives
  • Support Customer Success onboarding and enablement programs
  • Maintain a centralized sales content library and resources hub

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of sales enablement, sales training, or related experience in a B2B environment
  • Experience developing seller playbooks, battle cards, sales tools, and competitive content
  • Experience designing and delivering sales onboarding and training programs
  • Strong instructional design and content development skills
  • Exceptional PowerPoint and presentation development capabilities
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft Office applications

Preferred

  • Experience with sales enablement platforms such as Highspot, Seismic, or similar solutions
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • CRM experience, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 or equivalent platforms
  • Video learning and e-learning authoring experience (Articulate, Camtasia, or similar)
  • Experience in regulated industries
  • Background supporting both Sales and Customer Success organizations

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Competitive compensation ($125,000 - $135,000)
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid holidays and generous PTO
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative and growth-focused culture
  • Opportunity to build and shape a newly created strategic role
  • Work directly with leadership to drive sales and customer success performance
  • Join a stable, growing organization committed to innovation and safety

Who You Are

  • Passionate about helping sales professionals succeed
  • A confident trainer and facilitator who enjoys presenting to teams
  • Collaborative, curious, and solutions-oriented
  • Highly organized and detail-focused
  • Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities and recommending improvements
  • Customer-focused and committed to delivering business results

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help build the tools, training, and programs that enable our teams to succeed and our customers to thrive.

job.title: IT Support Specialist
job.description:
Onsite | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | Excellent Benefits

Are you a hands-on IT professional who enjoys troubleshooting technology, supporting users, and helping keep systems running smoothly?

Labelmaster is seeking an IT Support Specialist to provide day-to-day technical support across the organization. In this role, you will troubleshoot hardware and software issues, support Microsoft 365 applications, manage user accounts, deploy equipment, and help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment.

Labelmaster's mission is to simplify Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) compliance and shipping, helping make the world a safer place. Join our team and play a critical role in supporting the technology that keeps our business moving forward.

What You'll Do

  • Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot hardware and software.
  • Support employee onboarding, offboarding, password resets, and access management.
  • Assist with Microsoft 365 administration, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
  • Respond to help desk requests and document resolutions in the ticketing system.
  • Support IT security initiatives, software updates, and endpoint protection. 
  • Manage IT inventory, equipment deployment, and lifecycle replacement activities.
  • Assist with system upgrades, technology improvements, and special IT projects. 

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience supporting Windows-based environments. 
  • Experience with Windows 11 and Windows Server environments. 
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and desktop support. 
  • Experience with Active Directory, networking concepts, hardware repair, and troubleshooting. 
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with SQL Server, Exchange, WSUS, Mimecast, and Datto.
  • Experience supporting both onsite and remote users. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Competitive compensation ( $26.00 - $32.00 hourly)
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid holidays and generous PTO
  • Stable and growing organization
  • Collaborative team environment
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
